subject: Re: Kickoff: advice-based moment estimation — post-run decisions
body:
Team,

With last week's full-scale run in hand, decisions for the Jul 6 close:

1) Adoption recommendation is a yes, with Umar's blended mode as the default: advice-guided sampling with the ell_1 fallback engaging automatically on divergence. The full-scale numbers held up — error at one-third of the current pipeline's at equal budget, and the drain-event replay stayed safely above the plain-sampling floor with the blend on.
2) Weekly advice refresh is a hard operational requirement in the recommendation, with the N+4 staleness curve as the justification. Vera, please write the refresh runbook before rolling off — the telemetry on-call inherits this.
3) Scope cut: the unweighted_elements and weighted input types are documented but not productized; graph and net_traffic are what the customer runs.

Handoff review with the telemetry team is Jul 2. Thanks all — tidy project.

Anders
